youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for the friend who always carries others.

She: Jesus... I'm the strong one. Nobody ever asks me. 🪨
She: I carried three friends' crises this week, drove one to the airport at midnight. Mine stayed in my notes app, untouched.
Jesus: Bring them here. I never asked you to be the strong one. That title was never Mine to give.
She: But if I break, who holds everyone else together? They only know me as the steady one.
Jesus: Not your job, and it never was. Let Me hold you, and you will hold them better after.
Jesus: Your wilderness gets a way through it. Set the strong mask down tonight and let someone see you.
Send this to the strong friend. 🪨
